title: Saratoga Race Course

title: Investigation of organized crime in interstate commerce. Hearings before a Special Committee to Investigate Organized Crime in Interstate Commerce, United States Senate, Part 7 (New York-New Jersey)
venue: US Senate (Kefauver Committee), full text on archive.org
quote: the New York hearings involved Saratoga Springs.

limits: OCR text; absence of a word search is not proof every passage was read. Testimony concerns other Saratoga properties, not these two venues.
